theme_central: The certainty of the resurrection, down to the detail of fingerprints — the real cause of disbelief is love of this fleeting world.
sources_note: 2-ruku structure precisely sourced (grokipedia): 1-15, 16-40, with fine landmarks (1-4, 6-9, 16-19, 20-30, 31-40).

branches.title: Oath, resurrection in detail
branches.resume: Oath by the Day of resurrection; even fingerprints reconstituted; eclipses at the Judgment.

children.t: Oath by the Day, resurrection reconstituted down to the fingerprints
Mocking question about the timing, dazzled sight, eclipse of the sun and moon

branches.title: No refuge that Day
branches.resume: No possible escape; man himself a witness against himself despite his excuses.

children.t: No refuge that Day, man a witness against himself

branches.title: Preservation of the Qur'an
branches.resume: Intimate reassurance to the Prophet: not to rush his tongue, Allah takes charge of its preservation and explanation.

children.t: Preservation and explanation of the Qur'an ensured by Allah

branches.title: Vision of the pious, the agony
branches.resume: The pious will see their Lord; description of the agony of death, the shin that intertwines with the other.

children.t: Love of this world, the pious will see their Lord
Description of the agony of death

branches.title: The denier, closing
branches.resume: Portrait of the denier who turns away; does man think he will be left without account? Allah's ability to recreate.

children.t: The denier who turns away; Allah's ability to recreate man
